source: HeyRead li_account/GetAll + /campaign/GetAll + /stats/GetOverallStats, read-only. Credential env var: HEYREACH_KEY.

daily_capacity_healthy_only.note: Provider-configured ceilings summed over HEALTHY seats. This is what is ALLOWED, not what was sent, and not a promise LinkedIn tolerates it. Never raise a per-seat limit to gain throughput - add senders or add days.

capacity_on_in_progress_campaigns.note: Ceiling summed over healthy seats attached to at least one IN_PROGRESS campaign. These seats are already working.

capacity_on_idle_seats.note: Ceiling summed over healthy seats whose campaigns are all FINISHED/PAUSED/DRAFT. These seats look free but are still attached to campaigns and may need detachment before reuse.
